description: Upload a media file to the CRM file library from a URL.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

altId.description: Alternate ID (location ID or agency ID)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

fileUrl.description: Public URL of the file to upload

hosted.description: Whether the file is externally hosted

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name.description: Display name for the uploaded file

name: crm_upload_media_file
